turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: NVIDIA just announced OpenShell — a full reference architecture designed to govern and contain autonomous AI agents in production. Not a chip. Not a model. A governance stack, with ten major security partners already signed on.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: That's the thing nobody predicted. The chip company is now the safety company.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: And the safety company immediately requires more of the chip company's chips.
